theorems.name: Submission.radon_compactlySupported_countable_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X], ∃ g : ℕ → C_c(X, ℝ), ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), ∃ K : Set X, IsCompact K ∧ tsupport f ⊆ K ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ k : ℕ, tsupport (g k) ⊆ K ∧ ∀ x : X, |f x - g k x| ≤ η
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
